name: forge
description: Project FORGE: the machine that builds businesses. Monorepo for FORGE Command, API, orchestration and registries.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && node scripts/check-secrets.mjs
scripts.build:command: cd apps/command && npm ci && VITE_FORGE_API=/api/v1 npm run build
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run check && npm run build:command && cd services/api && npx wrangler deploy --env staging
